paper_title: Search for axion-like particles through nuclear Primakoff production using the GlueX detector
notes: First search for ALPs via nuclear Primakoff production at GlueX on a 12C target, exploring 200<m_a<450 MeV (2e8-4.5e8 eV) via X->gammagamma. Y-axis is the ALP-photon coupling 1/Lambda in GeV^-1 (mapped to AxionPhoton g_agamma). Limits are at the scale of O(1 TeV), i.e. ~few x10^-3 GeV^-1, with most stringent point ~360 MeV due to a background dip. Data points are approximate values read from Figs. 7-8 for the observed 95% CL limit from full carbon data; precise tabulated values not provided. Background-subtracted limits are somewhat weaker (~5e-3 to 1e-2). Projections (Pb target, empty-target, helium bag) are separate and not included. Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies.
